newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: AIR HOLDINGS 10 MONTH PROFIT 1996 NLG 3.4 MILLION.
newsitem.headline: AIR HOLDINGS 10 MONTH PROFIT 1996 NLG 3.4 MILLION.

text.p: Car dealership firm AIR Holding said it had made anet profit of 3.4 million guilders in the first ten months of 1996 on turnover of 169 million.
The company gave no comparative figures for the first ten months of 1995.
In August, AIR Holdings NV said it expected the 1996 full-year profit to be substantially higher than 1995's 2.1 million guilders.
In the first half of 1996, the company doubled its net profit to 2.4 million guilders, while turnover rose 27 percent to 106 million guilders.
